purpose: Etiquetar la attrition voluntaria observada de FY2026 debajo de la barra Rehire (1) de FY2026 en la lámina 16.

definition.concept: Realized fiscal-year voluntary attrition for the Rehire (1) population
definition.population: Active Regular Employees with is_rehire = 1 at FY2026 monthly snapshots
definition.denominator: Average monthly active-Rehire headcount across the 12 FY2026 snapshots
definition.numerator: Distinct employee-term-date VOLUNTARY events during FY2026 whose employee had an earlier FY2026 active-Rehire snapshot
definition.grain: Employee-snapshot exposure for the denominator; employee-term-date for voluntary exits
definition.not_equivalent_to: The prospective 12-month attrition target used for FY2024 and FY2025 labels

acceptance_rule: Publish only if FY2026 contains at least 12 observed monthly snapshots, at least 30 Rehire employee-snapshot exposures, and at least 30 distinct Rehire employees; label it observed, not prospective.
